chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, raising it, said:
He said: On the Day of Resurrection, three will be upon dunes of musk — one of them a Muezzin who called the Adhan with anticipation (of reward).
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a Muezzin who calls the Adhan with sincere intention?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration to emphasize the high status of the Mu'adhdhin who performs the call to prayer with 'ihtisab' (seeking Allah's pleasure) rather than for worldly recognition. This elevates the ritual from a mere announcement to a profound act of worship, promising the Mu'adhdhin a place of honor on dunes of musk on the Day of Resurrection, a symbol of purity and divine favor in Shia eschatology.
